cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: File the bakery's contract rejection under training, please. This is exactly how we learn not to depend on one customer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We needed that contract to pay the mixer loan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the lesson arrived just in time. Write down how many loaves we can make by hand. No, not how many we wish we could make.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Forty. That won't cover the payments either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then write 'closure plan' at the top. This is how we learn to let a failed plan go. Start with tomorrow's customers; they need calling before we order flour.

reason: Replace causally unsupported batch-halving with a legible closure decision prompted by insufficient hand production, still reframed as a necessary lesson.
